x: Besides Ray others in the fight for a place will probably be Ronnie Wallwork (The Commonwealth title holder), Shaun Lightman (Metropolitan W.C.), Roy Lodge (Bromsgrove & Redditch A.C.), Bryan Eley (Bristol W.C.) and Jake Warhurst (Sheffield U.H.).
This was Jake Warhurst's day but not Belgrave's. Ray Middleton powered through for 4th place and Carl Lawton hung on for 6th.
Third was Jake Warhurst who put in a final burst to pull up past the flagging Flynn. Carl, only a week after his wedding, turned in a stormer to finish 7th in a personal National '10' best.

By 15 km the leading group had split and was left with Roger Mills, Jake Warhurst and Bob Dobson contesting. The Bels retained their dominance although the positions had changed to Len, Carl, John, Allan and Ray.
Third man to finish was Jake Warhurst (Sheffield) a 50 kilo's specialist who obviously came through very strongly to lead his club to a decisive win.

For a long way he was in the lead with Jake Warhurst (Sheffield) but eventually got away, although the Sheffield man was pulling him back towards the end Sheffield won the team title to make a clean sweep of the R.W.A.
There was general pleasure that his last walk for us (for a while) brought him a fine win over the Sheffield 50 Kilos specialist, Jake Warhurst.
